$comment: Worker tests the Rust backend must pass (phase P2, scripts/rust-conformance.ts). One suite per ported module or core route group: the worker package that owns the tests, and the test files covering what Rust serves. A module is added when it is ported (playbook step 5). A ported module must reach every route of its suites; a route left out on purpose goes in the suite's `excludedRoutes`, with the reason.

Tested on TypeScript in routes/portal.test.ts.
